​I recently visited this location and was very pleased with the overall experience. The first thing I noticed was how clean and well-maintained the entire establishment is. featured_reviews.name: Sureshkumar Nagarajan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited PVR LIDO Juhu for the first time on 21st Sept 2025 to watch "The God Father" Rerelease!

This property is easy to navigate and it is just right on the main road side.

Really impressed with the colourful entrance. Though it is a smaller in size, but the aesthetical looks stunned me.
It given me dazzling bollywood look and feel!!
The Lobbies from main entrance to each theatres are featuring great interiors 👍👍

This property has 3 screens. While screen 1 and 2 are compact theatres, Screen 3 is a bit bigger.

Seatings are at top most comfort with food tray attached to each seat. Each row has big legroom.

Provided Screen size is maximum with respect to Auditorium size is a big plus.

They equipment Atmos system for even these small auditorium. Only drawback in Audio during my show was there was a beep sound making noise in the background.

Projection clarity is too good.

Airconditioning was just right.

Wash rooms are well installed and maintenaned.

Free drinking water facility is good and appreciable.

F&B items prices are high as usual for a PVR cinema.

Major drawback in this entire premises is Low Mobile Network.

Overall it is a nice and different cinema experience in PVR LIDO. Be prepared to watch movie here in a compact sized Theatres. If you come with an expectation of bigger screen experience, PVR LIDO may disappoint you.
Good idea to bring kids to this theater!!!

featured_reviews.name: Geeta Pariani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have no complaints about this multi screen cinema complex. The seating, the ambiance, the maintenance are all top notch. The only complaint I have is the sound volume in the hall. Whether it is ads, previews or the main feature film, the volume of the sound system is too loud. Yesterday I watched a film and came back with ringing ears. Despite requesting a staff member at the start of the film, nothing was done about this. I have decided that I shall either not return to this place or, if I have no other choice, I'll wear ear plugs to muffle the decibel level. Patrons may not realise now, but listening to such high volumes over even a short duration, can and will make one lose their hearing faculty.
This is very serious and ALL CINEMA HALLS SHOULD HAVE A DECIBEL MEASURING SYSTEM IN PLACE.
I KNOW WHAT IT IS TO HAVE A HEARING IMPAIRMENT. My son is hearing impaired.

DO NOT RISK YOUR EARS by allowing cinema halls to force you to listen to such high volumes

Not sure if hes pocketing it or it's going to legit use. all in all, lots of things to look into.

featured_reviews.name: Jainam
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this to warn everyone about the severe lack of safety and basic humanity at Roxy Cinema. Yesterday, my mother attended the 10 PM show of 'Dhabkaaro'. As the crowd was exiting the lift, a heavy ceiling tile suddenly collapsed and fell onto the people below. Two people were injured badly and bleeding, and heavy tile pieces hit my mother's head.
While accidents can happen, the theatre staff's reaction was absolutely disgusting. They were completely uncooperative. Nobody stepped forward to offer basic first aid, medical support, or even a glass of water to the bleeding and injured patrons. We had to literally shout and threaten to call the police just to get them to act, and even then, they helped completely half-heartedly.
We are now dealing with significant medical expenses, and the theatre management hasn't even had the decency to offer a simple apology. They clearly do not care about the safety or lives of their customers. Avoid this theatre at all costs unless you want to put your life at risk.

featured_reviews.name: Kunal Phadnis
featured_reviews.review_text:
Roxy Cinemas, Charni Road is an Art Deco-style single-screen theater located in South Mumbai. While it offers a nostalgic and budget-friendly movie-going experience, recent reviews suggest that the quality of its facilities has significantly declined over time.
Affordable ticket pricing makes it a popular spot for college students and families looking for a low-cost outing.
Many visitors praise the sound quality and screen clarity, noting that it provides a decent viewing experience despite being an older venue.
The seating is frequently criticized for being torn, uncomfortable, or poorly maintained, with some reviewers noting a lack of cleanliness in the auditorium.
Management issues are a common theme in complaints, specifically regarding long exit processes, unhelpful staff, and unsanitary restroom conditions.
The food court offers classic cinema snacks like popcorn and samosas, though some guests find the pricing to be high relative to the theater's overall quality.
Overall, it is a suitable choice

featured_reviews.name: Stringzzz
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Metro INOX Cinema, and my overall experience was extremely enjoyable and comfortable. This cinema hall perfectly blends a classic feel with modern movie-watching amenities, making it a great choice for both regular viewers and cinema lovers who appreciate a well-maintained theatre.

The screen and sound quality were excellent. The visuals were sharp, bright, and immersive, which made the movie even more engaging. The sound system was well balanced—loud enough to create impact without being overwhelming. Dialogues were clear, and background music and effects were crisp, enhancing the overall cinematic experience.

The seating arrangement deserves special mention. The seats were comfortable, well-spaced, and offered a clear view of the screen from almost every angle. Legroom was sufficient, allowing for a relaxed experience even during a long movie. The auditorium was clean and well maintained, which added to the comfort level.

The ambience of Metro INOX has a pleasant and premium feel. The lobby area was neat, organized, and not overly crowded. The lighting and interiors give a classy vibe, making the wait time before the show quite comfortable. Entry and exit were well managed, avoiding unnecessary rush or confusion.

Food and beverages were also satisfactory. The snacks counter offered the usual cinema favourites like popcorn, cold drinks, and nachos. While prices are on the higher side—as expected in multiplexes—the quality and freshness were good. The staff at the counter were polite and quick in handling orders, even during peak hours.

Another positive aspect was the staff behavior and overall management. The staff members were helpful, courteous, and ensured smooth operations throughout the show. Ticket checking, seating guidance, and cleanliness were handled efficiently. Restrooms were clean and well maintained, which is an important factor for any public place.

Overall, Metro INOX Cinema provides a reliable, comfortable, and enjoyable movie-watching experience. Whether you’re going for a weekend show with friends, a family outing, or a solo movie break, this place delivers on quality, comfort, and ambience. I would definitely recommend Metro INOX Cinema to anyone looking for a pleasant and hassle-free cinema experience.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the worst cinema experience at PVR Kandivali. To start with, water was literally leaking from the ceiling onto our seats. Instead of fixing the issue, they just threw a flimsy blue plastic sheet over the seats! It felt like sitting in a rundown shack. Some seats had broken cushions, making it incredibly uncomfortable to sit for the entire movie.

On top of that, the AC wasn’t working, and the whole theatre had a horrible damp, musty smell. It felt like they haven’t maintained the place in ages. The icing on the cake? The volume was cranked up so high, it was uncomfortable and borderline painful to sit through the movie. It didn’t enhance the experience, it made it worse.

This is hands down the worst PVR I’ve ever been to. If you’re planning to watch a movie here, do yourself a favor and go elsewhere. Total waste of time and money!

featured_reviews.name: Mayur Aundhakar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Maxus Cinemas on Gorai Road, Borivali West recently. Overall, the experience was decent, but there are a few areas that need improvement.

The biggest disappointment was that the movie started almost 30 minutes late, which was quite frustrating and affected the overall experience. The management should ensure better punctuality and timely show schedules.

The theatre is clean and the seating is comfortable. Food quality was surprisingly good, with decent options available and fresh snacks. However, the sound quality was slightly below expectations. The audio lacked depth and could definitely be improved for a better cinematic experience.

Despite these issues, the ambience is pleasant and it's still a good option for a casual movie outing with friends and family. Hoping they improve the sound system and maintain better show timings in the future.

⭐⭐⭐☆☆ (3/5)

featured_reviews.review_text:
Honestly, really disappointed with my experience at Maxsus Cinema. The picture quality was extremely poor — the screen looked blurry, as if the sharpness wasn’t even set properly. For a premium theatre, this is just unacceptable.

On top of that, the audio was even worse. The speakers were crackling throughout, completely ruining the movie experience. Instead of immersive sound, it felt like sitting next to a broken speaker system.

Even the food was a letdown. The ₹100 sandwich was pathetic — dry, swaggy, and didn’t even have proper butter applied. Completely not worth the price.

Overall, not worth the money at all. Definitely expected much better from a brand like this.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Audio and visual quality are impressive, with clear sound and sharp screen projection that enhance the cinematic experience. Cleanliness is well taken care of across the premises, including the seating areas and washrooms, which adds to the comfort.

Staff are courteous and helpful, and the entry and exit process is smooth without unnecessary delays. The food counter offers decent options, and service is efficient even during peak hours.

Overall, Maxus Theatre stands out as a reliable and comfortable theatre in Borivali, ideal for family outings as well as casual movie plans. Definitely a good choice for a hassle-free movie experience.

featured_reviews.review_text: I had a disappointing experience at the theater. The staff lacked knowledge about ticket information, leading to confusion. We arrived 15 minutes late, and our seats were occupied due to their error. The staff were unaware of ticket details and couldn't identify the correct seating. The manager eventually resolved the seat issue but refused a refund for the wasted 45 minutes of the movie, which we missed due to their irresponsibility. We had booked 6 tickets costing Rs. 280, and the wasted money adds to the dissatisfaction. The experience was unsatisfactory, and the management's response was inadequate. The staff's behavior was unprofessional, with one occupant arguing without knowledge, and the manager's attitude was unhelpful, stating "I can't say anything to the customer, they are my customer", making us question who we were in the situation. I suggest to avoid this theater
